mcpEnable.label: Enable MCP tools
mcpEnable.description: Allow users to select enabled MCP tools in conversations.

toolPrompt.label: MCP tool prompt
toolPrompt.description: Controls when and how the model calls MCP tools. Leave empty to use the built-in default prompt.

fields.defaultPromptPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the built-in default prompt

maxSelectedTools.label: Selectable tools per message
maxSelectedTools.description: Maximum MCP tools a user can select for one message. Default 32, maximum 128.

maxLLMCalls.label: Max LLM requests
maxLLMCalls.description: Total LLM requests allowed in one message, including the first request and final summary. Default 5, minimum 2.

maxToolCalls.label: Max MCP tool calls
maxToolCalls.description: Total MCP tool calls allowed in one message. Failed calls count toward the limit. Default 8.

maxConcurrentCalls.label: MCP tool concurrency
maxConcurrentCalls.description: Maximum concurrent MCP tool calls per service instance. Default 8.

toolTimeout.label: MCP tool timeout
toolTimeout.description: Maximum wait time for one MCP tool call, in seconds. Default 10.

toolRetry.label: MCP tool retries
toolRetry.description: Retry count after an MCP tool call fails. Default 0.

order.title: MCP display order
order.description: Configure how MCP servers and their tools appear in the conversation selector.
order.emptyTools: This server has no tools to order
order.saveFailed: Failed to save MCP display order

bulkConfirm.title: Confirm bulk action
bulkConfirm.description: Run this bulk action for {count} selected tools.

serverDialog.description: Configure the MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint and credentials.
serverDialog.name: Server name
serverDialog.authTokenConfiguredHelp: A bearer token is configured but is never loaded into this form. Leave this empty to keep it unchanged.
serverDialog.authTokenOptionalHelp: Optional bearer token. It is stored separately from custom Header templates.

headerTemplate.title: Custom Header template
headerTemplate.serverExpansion: DEEIX expands template values on the server for the selected runtime mode.
headerTemplate.backendAuthority: The backend is authoritative for duplicate or canonical Header conflicts, reserved-name blacklist, template syntax, and size or count limits.
headerTemplate.plaintextWarning: Custom Header template values are stored as plaintext. Do not place bearer tokens or other secrets here.
headerTemplate.blacklistWarning: Transport, authentication, tracing, MCP-*, Proxy-*, Sec-* and X-DEEIX-* Headers are blocked by the backend.
headerTemplate.maskedPreservation: Masked sensitive Header values returned by the server are preserved when unchanged; replace one only when rotating its value.

modeHelp.chat: Chat preview includes user, conversation, message, request, run and trace examples.
modeHelp.probe: Probe preview includes the acting user and request; conversation, message, run and trace values are empty.
modeHelp.sync: Sync preview includes only the request; user and chat-specific values are empty.

preflight.invalidJson: Enter valid JSON before requesting an authoritative preview.
preflight.objectRequired: The Header template must be a JSON object.
preflight.stringValuesRequired: Every Header template value must be a string.

preview.failed: Could not load the authoritative Header preview.
preview.emptyHeaders: No Headers are rendered for this template.

tokens.title: Supported DEEIX tokens
tokens.userPublicId: Authenticated user's public ID in chat and probe; empty during sync.
tokens.userDisplayName: Authenticated user's display name in chat and probe; empty during sync.
tokens.userEmail: Authenticated user's email in chat and probe; empty during sync.
tokens.userRole: Authenticated user's DEEIX role in chat and probe; empty during sync.
tokens.conversationPublicId: Persisted conversation public ID in chat; empty during probe and sync.
tokens.assistantMessagePublicId: Persisted assistant-message public ID in chat; empty during probe and sync.
tokens.userMessagePublicId: Persisted user-message public ID in chat; empty during probe and sync.
tokens.requestId: Normalized DEEIX request ID in chat, probe and sync.
tokens.runId: Authoritative generation run ID in chat; empty during probe and sync.
tokens.traceId: Active trace ID in chat; empty during probe and sync.
tokens.unknown: Supported by the backend; description is not available in this UI version.

warnings.title: Backend warnings
warnings.unknownToken: Header {header} references unsupported token {token}; the backend leaves it unchanged.
warnings.malformedToken: Header {header} contains malformed template syntax near {token}.
